summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by United Microelectronics Corporation reporting three routine corporate announcements. It discloses a capital reduction from the cancellation of restricted stock awards, the conversion price and premium rate for a new domestic unsecured convertible corporate bond, and director/officer share trading and pledges. These are ordinary operational and regulatory updates, not special-situation events. The capital reduction is de minimis (shares reduced from 12,546,433,870 to 12,539,542,899). The convertible bond issuance has an effective filing with the Taiwan FSC, with a conversion price of NT$130.7 per share. No transaction, campaign, or strategic action is involved.
